At AI Engineer, Cloudflare showed which parts of a build failure a classifier could handle. TypeSafe AI showed off their production customers. Today was the “System One day” of the second annual AIE CODE event , and somehow everything aligned: Richard covered Diogo’s triumphant return to AIE talking about the Jevolution with their most notable production customers since crossing $100M ARR In a BIG surprise, Google beat Anthropic to launching a production decision model, with Sundar and Logan announcing Gemini Decision 1 , a calibrated multimodal decision model capable of taking up to 1000 questions and costing $0.10 per million input with ~200ms e2e latency. Sponsored by SerpApi Give Your AI Agents the Full Page, Not Just the Link Retrieve public web pages by URL as clean Markdown, structured JSON, or raw HTML with SerpApi’s Extract API . Pair it with 100+ SerpApi search APIs to go from query to page content with one provider. Gemini Decisions API : Google introduced a new API backed by Gemini Decision 1 . The model handles closed-set decisions, so it scores choices in a single pass instead of generating text token by token ( Sundar Pichai , Logan Kilpatrick , Google ). Specs : It supports yes/no, multiple-choice and rubric scoring, with up to 255 multiple-choice options. It accepts text, image, audio, video and PDF inputs, handles up to 1,000 questions per request, has 256K context, returns answers in 150–250 ms end to end, and attaches a confidence score to every answer ( @_philschmid ). Pricing : $0.10 per 1M input tokens, with $0 billed for output. Google says that is about 5x cheaper than Flash-Lite ( Sundar ). Origin : The project started as an internal Google DeepMind prototype. A small team shipped the model and API about six weeks later ( @_philschmid ).
